newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products mixed: gasoline dives $8.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mixed: gasoline dives $8.

text.p: NWE oil products were mixed on Wednesday: gasoline was very weak but gas oil rose with crude, traders said.
Gasoline barges fell $7-$9 but cargoes were steady with the transatlantic arbitrage open.
Naphtha rallied sharply after crude shot up and speculation surfaced of the arbitrage to the U.S. opening, traders said.

Gas oil rallied $3 with futures but muted demand and ample immediate stocks helped push heating oil barge premiums $1 lower. Fuel oil was mostly weaker, with aggressive selling noted on the barge market.
